data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word ‘Ghusun’, meaning ‘delicacy’ or ‘fragility’. In Islamic tradition, Ghusoun represents the tender, gentle, and refined aspects of a woman's character. The name Ghusoun carries the meaning “Delicacy, Fragility” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghusoun usually hope their child will grow to embody delicacy, fragility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
